QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) is the library's own user of this mechanism. It: ... calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(buffer_alloc_calloc_mutexed, buffer_alloc_free_mutexed)` (or the non-mutexed pair)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator's init function as the library's own user of the runtime setter, installing its allocator functions over the pointers. It doesn't say "only", but "the library's own user" conveys it.
